meta.name: env-and-assets-bootstrap
meta.description: Rigor Setup skill for README-first deep learning repo reproduction. Use when the task is specifically to prepare a conservative conda-first environment, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache location hints, and setup notes before any run on a README-documented repository. Do not use for repo scanning, full orchestration, paper interpretation, final run reporting, or generic environment setup that is not tied to a specific reproduction target.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑开源深度学习项目前,先把运行环境、权重与数据路径备好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果拿到一个深度学习仓库却卡在环境与路径配置上
copy.tagline_en: Prepare environment, checkpoints, and data paths before running a deep learning repo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a deep learning repo won't run and you're stuck on setup and paths

howto.what: 为 README 文档的深度学习复现仓库做跑前准备:给出保守的 conda 环境方案、checkpoint 与数据集路径假设、缓存位置提示和 setup 笔记,并列出候选 conda 命令与未解决的依赖/资产风险。
howto.when: 当仓库已锁定可信复现目标,需要在运行任何命令前准备环境或资产路径时触发;仅扫描规划、只报告已跑结果,或与复现无关的通用 conda 问题不适用。

say.text: 帮我为这个复现仓库准备 conda 环境和数据集路径假设
say.note: 会产出候选 conda 命令与路径计划

say.text: 这个仓库依赖 checkpoint,先给我一份资产准备清单
say.note: 输出 checkpoint 来源提示与风险项

say.text: 在跑之前,把环境和缓存目录的假设写下来
say.note: 生成保守 setup 笔记与未决风险

howto.what_en: Prepares a README-documented deep learning repo before any run: conservative conda environment notes, checkpoint and dataset path assumptions, cache hints, setup notes, candidate conda commands, and unresolved dependency or asset risks.
howto.when_en: Triggers after repo intake locks a credible reproduction target, when environment or asset paths must be prepared before running commands. Not for scanning-only, reporting past runs, or generic conda questions.

say_en.text: Set up a conda env and dataset path assumptions for this repo
say_en.note: Outputs candidate conda commands and a path plan

say_en.text: This repo needs checkpoints; give me an asset prep checklist
say_en.note: Lists checkpoint source hints and risks

say_en.text: Before running, write down the env and cache assumptions
say_en.note: Produces conservative setup notes and open risks
